title: ARC Control Agent
description: An agent is the principal ARC Control authorizes. It is never a human: a human acts through the console or an approval, an agent acts through the gateway. Every agent has an owner who is accountable for what it does.

id.description: Opaque identifier assigned by ARC Control.

name.description: Stable handle used in policies and audit records, e.g. "finance-agent".

status.description: A suspended agent is refused at authentication, before policy is consulted.

environment.description: Deployment environment; policies may scope to it.

owner.description: The human or team accountable for this agent. Resolves the `owner` approver selector.

roles.description: Roles the agent holds. Policies match on these rather than naming agents directly.

declaredTools.description: Tools the agent declares it needs. Advisory: policy still decides every call.
